project_name: AI-Based Early Vector-Borne Disease Prevention System
dashboard_name: VectorSafe AI – Environmental Mosquito Suitability Dashboard
score_interpretation: Formula-derived environmental suitability proxy; not confirmed dengue prediction, disease diagnosis, observed mosquito abundance, or confirmed breeding-ground detection.
satellite_source: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A accessed through Microsoft Planetary Computer
weather_source: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API, using ECMWF ERA5 / ERA5-Land where applicable
model_pipeline: RF1 Random Forest environmental model + ResNet-18 satellite-image features + RF2 Random Forest fusion
model_version: Existing RF2 artifact; formal run manifest pending
limitations: EMSS is a formula-derived environmental proxy.
The system does not predict confirmed dengue cases or disease outbreaks.
The system does not confirm mosquito presence or breeding grounds.
Low, Medium, and High bands are visualization thresholds for inspection prioritization.
Results apply only to stored Bhopal-area samples within a 50 km radius and the documented date range.
